# Better Form

> Better Form (https://betterform.dev) is a form builder: sign-ups, RSVPs, applications, surveys, quizzes, waivers and signed contracts. AI agents can create a form for a user with one HTTP request. No account or API key is needed.

## MCP server

If your client supports MCP connectors, add `https://betterform.dev/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no auth). It provides `create_form`, `update_form` and `get_form`, which do the same things as the HTTP API below. Otherwise use the HTTP API.

## Create a form for a user

1. Build the form definition (schema below).
2. `POST https://betterform.dev/api/agent/forms` with `Content-Type: application/json`.
3. Give the user the `claimUrl` from the response. That is the main deliverable.

The user opens the `claimUrl`, sees a preview, and clicks "Add to my account" (signing up first if they need to). The form is then theirs to edit and share. **The form does not accept responses until it has been claimed.** Unclaimed forms are deleted after 14 days.

Treat `claimUrl` as private to the user who asked: anyone who opens it can claim the form. If the user wants something to show others before claiming, give them `previewUrl`, which is read-only.

### Example

```bash
curl -X POST https://betterform.dev/api/agent/forms \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Robotics Club Fall Sign-up",
    "theme": "blue",
    "successMessage": "Thanks! See you at the first meeting.",
    "fields": [
      { "type": "text", "label": "Welcome!", "description": "Meetings are Tuesdays at 4pm in Room 204." },
      { "type": "short_text", "label": "Full name", "required": true },
      { "type": "email", "label": "Email", "required": true },
      { "type": "dropdown", "label": "Grade", "options": ["9", "10", "11", "12"], "required": true },
      { "type": "checkboxes", "label": "Which teams interest you?", "options": ["Build", "Programming", "Design", "Outreach"] },
      { "type": "scale", "label": "Prior robotics experience", "scaleStyle": "numbers", "scaleMax": 5 },
      { "type": "paragraph", "label": "Anything else we should know?" }
    ]
  }'
```

Response (`201`):

```json
{
  "formId": "…",
  "name": "Robotics Club Fall Sign-up",
  "fields": [ … ],
  "previewUrl": "https://betterform.dev/preview/…",
  "claimUrl": "https://betterform.dev/claim/bf_claim_…",
  "editToken": "bf_edit_…",
  "expiresAt": "2026-10-30T12:00:00.000Z",
  "instructions": "…"
}
```

Suggested reply to the user: "Here's your form: {claimUrl}. Open it to preview it, then click **Add to my account** to edit it and get a link to share."

## Form definition

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string, required | Form title, at most 200 characters. |
| `fields` | array, required | 1–100 fields, shown in order. |
| `theme` | string | `slate`, `blue` (default), `green`, `purple` or `pink`. |
| `successMessage` | string | Shown after someone submits, at most 500 characters. |

Every field has `type` and `label`, plus optional `description` (help text) and `required` (boolean). `id` is optional: omit it and one is generated.

| `type` | Use for | Extra keys |
|---|---|---|
| `short_text` | Names, one-line answers | |
| `paragraph` | Long answers | |
| `email` | Email address | |
| `phone` | Phone number | |
| `multiple_choice` | Pick one (radio buttons) | `options`: array of strings, required |
| `dropdown` | Pick one from a long list | `options`: array of strings, required |
| `checkboxes` | Pick any number | `options`: array of strings, required |
| `date` | A date | |
| `time` | A time | |
| `scale` | Ratings | `scaleStyle`: `numbers` (default), `stars` or `faces`; `scaleMax`: 2–5 (default 5) |
| `file_upload` | Files | `maxFiles`: 1–10 (default 1); `allowedFileTypes`: e.g. `["image/*", ".pdf"]` |
| `text` | Static heading and paragraph, no input | `label` is the heading (may be empty), `description` is the body |
| `section` | Page break; later fields go on the next page | `label` optional |
| `legal_text` | Contract or waiver terms shown in a scroll box | `content`: required, the full text |
| `signature` | Signature, for waivers and contracts | `signatureMode`: `draw`, `type` or `either` (default) |

Adding a `signature` field automatically adds a required, verified email field if the form doesn't already have one.

Payments, quizzes, response limits, deadlines and notification settings are not available through this API. Tell the user they can turn them on in the editor after claiming the form.

## Revise a form before it's claimed

Send the complete updated definition (same shape as create). It replaces the previous version. The `claimUrl` stays the same.

```
PATCH https://betterform.dev/api/agent/forms/{formId}
Authorization: Bearer {editToken}
Content-Type: application/json
```

`GET` on the same URL with the same header returns the current definition. Once the user claims the form, the `editToken` stops working (`404`), and only the owner can change the form in the Better Form editor.

## Errors

- `422 validation_failed`: `issues` lists each problem as `{ "path": "fields[2].options", "message": "…" }`. Fix those paths and retry.
- `429 rate_limited`: too many forms created from this network in the last hour. Revise an existing form with its `editToken` instead.
- `404 not_found` on PATCH or GET: wrong id or token, or the form was already claimed or expired.
